mapper.select: SELECT cs.uuid, cs.external_id, cs.organization_uuid, cs.workspace_uuid, cs.session_external_id, cs.current_worker_epoch, cs.worker_claim_attempts FROM code_sessions cs LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.uuid = cs.session_uuid AND s.organization_uuid = cs.organization_uuid AND s.workspace_uuid = cs.workspace_uuid AND s.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE cs.deleted_at IS NULL AND cs.status = 'active' AND cs.metadata #>> '{config,worker_transport}' = 'claim' AND s.uuid IS NOT NULL AND (cs.worker_claim_expires_at IS NULL OR cs.worker_claim_expires_at <= NOW()) AND (cs.worker_lease_expires_at IS NULL OR cs.worker_lease_expires_at + #{leaseGraceMicros} * INTERVAL '1 microsecond' < NOW()) AND (cs.worker_claim_requested_at IS NOT NULL OR s.status IN ('running', 'rescheduling')) ORDER BY COALESCE(cs.worker_claim_requested_at, cs.worker_lease_expires_at, cs.updated_at) ASC, cs.uuid ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF cs SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE code_sessions SET current_worker_epoch = current_worker_epoch + 1, oauth_access_token_hash = #{params.OAuthAccessTokenHash,sensitive=true}, worker_lease_expires_at = NULL, connection_status = 'disconnected', idle_since = NULL, worker_claimed_by = #{params.WorkerID}, worker_claim_expires_at = #{params.ClaimExpiresAt}, worker_claim_attempts = worker_claim_attempts + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{params.UUID} RETURNING current_worker_epoch

UPDATE code_sessions SET current_worker_epoch = current_worker_epoch + CASE WHEN worker_claimed_by IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, worker_claimed_by = NULL, worker_claim_requested_at = NULL, worker_lease_expires_at = NULL, connection_status = 'disconnected', worker_claim_expires_at = #{holdUntil}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{uuid} RETURNING current_worker_epoch
UPDATE code_sessions SET worker_claim_attempts = 0, worker_claim_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{uuid} AND current_worker_epoch = #{epoch} AND worker_claim_requested_at IS NULL

UPDATE code_sessions SET current_worker_epoch = current_worker_epoch + 1, worker_claimed_by = NULL, worker_claim_requested_at = NULL, worker_lease_expires_at = NULL, connection_status = 'disconnected', worker_claim_expires_at = #{params.HoldUntil}, worker_claim_attempts = GREATEST(worker_claim_attempts, #{params.MaxAttempts}), updated_at = NOW() WHERE external_id = #{params.ExternalID} AND current_worker_epoch = #{params.Epoch} AND worker_claimed_by = #{params.WorkerID} AND status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING uuid, current_worker_epoch

UPDATE code_sessions SET worker_lease_expires_at = NULL, connection_status = 'disconnected',
worker_claim_requested_at = COALESCE(worker_claim_requested_at, NOW()), worker_claim_expires_at = NOW() + LEAST(5 * POWER(2, GREATEST(worker_claim_attempts - 1, 0)), 300) * INTERVAL '1 second',
worker_claim_requested_at = COALESCE(worker_claim_requested_at, NOW()), worker_claim_expires_at = NOW(), worker_claim_attempts = GREATEST(worker_claim_attempts - 1, 0),
worker_claim_expires_at = NOW(),
updated_at = NOW() WHERE external_id = #{params.ExternalID} AND current_worker_epoch = #{params.Epoch} AND worker_claimed_by = #{params.WorkerID} AND status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(metadata #>> '{config,worker_transport}', '') AS worker_transport FROM code_sessions WHERE external_id = #{externalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL
